scope: Fix problems found in a full check of the app. Your words are kept, and fewer things stop the app.

topics.title: Spell email addresses
details: Say underscore for _ and dash for - in an email address. For example, say sam underscore lee at example dot com.
A period that speech adds at the end of an address is now ignored.

topics.title: Which browser
details: If your chosen browser cannot start, the app uses its own Firefox. Say Which browser to hear this. Your choice stays saved for next time.

topics.title: Your words are kept
details: Some sentences start like a command, such as Rate this product or Use the back door at night. Before, the app could drop them. Now they are written into your document, email or note.
Change font to Arial now changes the font. It no longer replaces the word font in your text. Line spacing and font size work the same way.
Say Delete paragraph, then Delete selection. The words of the next paragraph now stay.
Read paragraph on an empty paragraph keeps your place there. What you say next goes there too.
The words re-read and co-convene stay as you said them. The trial period keeps the word period.

topics.title: Fewer stops
details: An empty or damaged Word file now gives a message. It no longer stops the app.
New paragraph in an empty document works. Reading or writing next no longer stops the app.
A file that is open in another program no longer stops the app when you type. The app tells you it will save later.
Changing the sending account from the inbox now returns you to the main menu.

topics.title: Word files and tables
details: Text that is not bold or not underlined stays that way after you save. A 10.5 point font stays 10.5 points.
Changing or pasting across two table cells is refused with a message. Before, it could break the table so it could not be saved.
Delete line now removes only the current line.

topics.title: Email
details: Delete and move now work for Yahoo mail.
In Dictation only, saying Yes at the send review sends the email. It is no longer typed into the message.
Some words can follow an address, as in bob at example dot com next week. They are no longer added to the address.
A reply sent from Outlook goes to the address you typed in the To field.
Your sending account no longer changes by itself when Gmail renews its sign-in.
Messages sent on a Tuesday or Thursday now read their date.

topics.title: Web
details: Open website VA dot gov now works even when speech adds a period at the end. Forward slash works too.
Typing a number such as 98.6 in the search box now searches for it.
Some news sites copy their links in a moving row. Those links now open.

If you press Cancel on the browser bar that says Voice Companion is debugging this browser, the tab now stays unlinked. Choose Connect in the extension to link it again. If you loaded the extension yourself, choose Reload once on its card.

topics.title: Radio, podcasts and updates
details: The saved recordings list now plays the recording you hear named.
Download episode 0 now says there is no such number. Before, it got the last episode.
Search for stations in the US. You no longer get ones from Russia or Australia.
Old update files are now removed. This frees disk space.
